purpose: Check whether a paid MSIX screenshot/image preflight desktop utility is differentiated from newly identified free local-first alternatives; source claims are not installation or buyer evidence.

new_competitors.name: Systron App Store Asset Generator
claims: vendor says images are not uploaded to server
new_competitors.overlap: A free tool already claims Microsoft Store-specific local image preparation and batch output, overlapping a paid preflight desk.
new_competitors.critical_discrepancy: Vendor reference states Microsoft Store desktop screenshots can be PNG or JPEG, while Microsoft Learn MSIX documentation explicitly requires .png. Do not rely on the vendor reference as compliance authority.
new_competitors.evidence_quality: Vendor claims; not independently executed or audited

new_competitors.name: WinStorePackager
new_competitors.type: Open-source local-first Windows MSIX packaging GUI
new_competitors.price: MIT licensed public repository; no paid price claimed
claims: Windows MSIX packaging and signing workflow
Japanese and English among supported GUI languages
new_competitors.overlap: Local Store asset preparation and preflight are available within a broader open-source workflow.
new_competitors.limitation: Feature descriptions are README claims; no install, security review or current release verification. It is not proven to offer identical per-image rejection diagnostics.
new_competitors.evidence_quality: Public GitHub repository README and MIT license metadata

new_competitors.name: Microsoft Store Asset Guidance Kit for Figma
new_competitors.overlap: Official asset design templates already exist; any paid checker needs more than static sizing help.

official_rule_check.important: 1024x768 is GUI usability test size, not valid desktop screenshot size; official documentation takes precedence over conflicting vendor tables.
official_rule_check.scope: MSIX app listing; does not imply all PWA/EXE routes have identical rules

candidate_advantages_still_unproven: A deterministic, Microsoft-documented, versioned MSIX profile that rejects JPEG even when third-party templates mistakenly accept it
One offline JA/EN batch checklist with exact file-level errors and no file modification
Per-language missing/invalid asset detection plus a human-readable export that nontechnical developers can act on

test_matrix.official_expected: REJECT as MSIX screenshot; PNG required
test_matrix.competitor_comparison: Systron spec reference vs actual output

test_matrix.official_expected: Format and minimum dimensions pass only; not full submission approval
REJECT or flag excess relative to documented maximum 10

test_matrix.case: JA and EN listing sets with missing JA image
test_matrix.official_expected: Flag missing localized image in proposed workflow; Microsoft says upload images for each language
Safe reject without overwrite or crash

commercial_decision: HOLD: official MSIX preset and no-upload batch asset handling are already available in free or open-source alternatives; no validated why-pay, buyer willingness, or 2 proven advantages. Do not expand product, commercial-build MSIX, bind new Identity, submit, or upgrade the score without primary evidence.
followup: Recruit 5 target independent Store developers; record task completion, errors and willingness to pay against free tools. Collect 10 direct dated Store reviews. If distinct value is not demonstrated, retain free utility or stop paid launch.
source_provenance: Desk review of linked public pages on 2026-10-31. No app installs, Windows GUI tests, buyer interviews or Store uploads were performed.
